definitions.explanation: A clinic run by a licensed bonesetter ({柔道整復師|じゅうどうせいふくし}) that treats bone fractures, sprains, joint problems, and musculoskeletal issues through manual therapy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足首|あしくび}→足首：00918_ashikubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捻挫|ねんざ}→捻挫：05016_nenza⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{接骨院|せっこついん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I sprained my ankle and went to a bone-setting clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{接骨院|せっこついん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A new bone-setting clinic opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{怪我|けが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{整形外科|せいけいげか}→整形外科：22066_seikeigeka⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{接骨院|せっこついん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧よい。
examples.english: When you get a sports injury, it's good to go to an orthopedic clinic or a bone-setting clinic.

notes:
Compound of {接骨|せっこつ} (bonesetting) + {院|いん} (institution, clinic). These clinics are widespread in Japan and treat musculoskeletal problems using hands-on techniques.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接骨院|せっこついん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to go to a bone-setting clinic regularly
- {接骨院|せっこついん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive treatment at a bone-setting clinic
- {接骨院|せっこついん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to open a bone-setting practice

CULTURAL NOTE:
Bone-setting clinics are extremely common in Japan, found in most neighborhoods. They are staffed by {柔道整復師|じゅうどうせいふくし} (licensed bonesetters), whose practice historically developed from martial arts injury treatment. National health insurance covers some treatments.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{整骨院|せいこついん}→整骨院：18136_seikotsuin⟧: same as {接骨院|せっこついん} — alternative name for the same type of clinic
- ⟦{整形外科|せいけいげか}→整形外科：22066_seikeigeka⟧: orthopedic surgery/clinic — Western medical approach; uses X-rays, surgery
- ⟦{整体|せいたい}→整体：27407_seitai⟧: chiropractic, bodywork — unlicensed practice; not covered by insurance
